rationale: SA has gapped down nearly 15% from prior close and is trading at 2.6% of today's range, sitting just above the session low of $17.78 with price continuing to drift lower in the last five candles. While the extreme relative volume (16.68x) and proximity to the low could suggest a bounce, the stock is well below VWAP ($19.02) and the 9-EMA ($18.15), and the broader market is under significant stress (SPY -1.23%, VIXY +7.50%), making a sustained reversal unlikely. The risk/reward for either direction is unclear — a long risks continuation of the downtrend with no structural support visible, and a short this close to the session low with high volatility risks a sharp snap-back; skipping preserves capital.
